source_fact_policy: Every factual proposition is a disposition over an exact active ledger claim ID. No browser observation, catalog analogy, or uncited source fact is added.

scene_state_transition_model.statement: The component starts with null game state and results, start game phase, and a one-shot completion-report reference; reset creates state from vocabulary, difficulty, and creature and clears results/reporting state.
The configured play space is 390 by 700 with a 100 by 60 exit gate, player speed 200, player radius 12, and initial health 100.
The component supports arrow/WASD keyboard listeners and a playing-state D-pad velocity adapter; the simulation clamps player coordinates to the configured bounds.
The source defines creature patrol/chase configuration, a sight-radius chase branch, and circular patrol-position calculation when not chasing.
The state update contains a radius-based collision damage branch and a defeat transition when resulting health is at or below zero.
Crystal overlap compares the current crystal word with the target word; correct words advance ordered progression and wrong words damage health and increment wrong answers without advancing.
After all target words are reached, the gate unlocks and proximity to its center produces the source-defined victory transition.
Rendering derives scale from container dimensions against the configured game dimensions, with a zero-dimension fallback of one.
On victory or defeat, the component computes accuracy and XP, enters ended phase, and calls onComplete once through its report guard.
The locale page fetches the Shadow Gate Dungeon sentences endpoint and its completion callback stores local result values and posts completion fields to the completion endpoint.
The sentences endpoint is declared as a force-static GET route configured with SAMPLE_SENTENCES.

mechanics_learning_model.statement: Movement and stealth requirements are represented by configured speed/radius values, keyboard and D-pad adapters, bounds clamping, chase timing, and circular patrol calculation.

The learning interaction is ordered crystal overlap: the target word determines correctness, correct collection advances the target index, and wrong words preserve the target index while applying the cited wrong-answer effects.
The terminal state model contains source-defined victory after ordered progression and gate proximity, and defeat after collision damage reaches zero health.
The component result path computes accuracy and XP and reports once, while the page submits the cited completion fields; these are source wiring propositions only.

developer_effort_model.statement: Account for initialization/reset state, keyboard listeners, and D-pad velocity adaptation.
Account for configured world values, bounded movement, chase/patrol state updates, and collision damage handling.
Account for ordered crystal progression, gate victory, defeat, and result callback behavior.
Account for source-defined scale calculation, locale sentence loading, completion submission wiring, and the sentences route declaration without asserting execution or correctness.
